title: Chapter 15 exercise (end): blanks (xvii)–(xx)

paras.en: (xvii) Abd al-Malik had the commentary of the Holy Quran written by ........
paras.ur: (xvii) عبد الملک نے ........ سے قرآنِ پاک کی تفسیر لکھوائی۔
paras.ps: (xvii) عبدالملک ........ نه د قرآن پاک تفسیر ولیکه.

paras.ur: (xix) حجاج نے باغی جرنیل ........ کو شکست دی۔
paras.ps: (xix) حجاج باغي جنرال ........ ته ماته ورکړه.

paras.ur: (xx) حجاج کا انتقال ........ ہجری میں ہوا۔
paras.ps: (xx) حجاج وفات په ........ هجري کې وشو.

sourceNote: Printed page 258: the last four blanks of question 8 of the exercise of Chapter 15, followed by a row of three stars; the rest of the page is blank (faint show-through). The handwritten answers written in the blanks (e.g. “Sa’id bin Musayyab”, “Taif”, “Ibn Ash’ath”, “95”) are excluded and the blanks are left empty. English and Pashto are our translations (need native review); watermark, handwriting, page-edge shadows, a thumb at the page edge and ornamental borders excluded. Scan n = printed page n-1 (file = {p//2+1:03d}_page_2 for even printed page p, {(p-1)//2+1:03d}_page_1 for odd p).
